model_year.note: Label for the year whose specs are quoted. Not a statement about availability.

length_in.note: Volvo Car USA EX40 specifications, 'Vehicle length'. Overview page is titled 2026 Volvo EX40.

awd.label: Twin Motor
awd.note: 'Driveline': Single Motor Extended Range 'RWD'; Twin Motor 'AWD'.

adapter.note: 'Adapters will be included as standard equipment with MY2025 EX90, EX40 and EC40.' The page doesn't say whether this continues for MY2026.

charge_port.note: Volvo's NACS page lists EX40 among models that reach Superchargers via the 'NACS Fast Charging Adapter', which implies a CCS1 port. EX40 overview: 'Volvo Car electric vehicles now support the North American Charging Standard'.

supercharger_access.note: Volvo's NACS page, 'Which fully electric Volvo models can access the Tesla Supercharger Network?': 'The Volvo EX90, EX30, EX40, EC40, XC40 Recharge and C40 Recharge can access the network.'

cross_check.note: Tesla lists Volvo among manufacturers with access to NACS Superchargers; 'can be accessed through an adapter. The adapter has to be provided by your vehicle manufacturer.' Read through headless Edge (sources/tesla-supercharging-other-evs-rendered.html); curl gets HTTP 403.

us_status.note: Volvo Car USA overview: '2026 / Model Year', MSRPs, inventory links. Volvo's US media home also links a 2027 EX40 page (not fetched; media model pages returned 503).

entries.note: 'Battery capacity' 82.0 kWh; data key 'batteryNominalEnergy', read as gross.
C/D test sheet 'Peak DC Fast-Charge Rate: 205 kW' for a car with a 79.0-kWh pack, so an earlier model year than the 82.0-kWh 2026. Volvo's pages give only the 200 kW charger used for its 10-80% time.
'Charge time (10-80%) (as fast as)' 28.0 min for both drivelines. Overview page: 'typical time to charge from 10 to 80 percent at a 200kW DC fast charging station'.

Features list on Volvo's US specifications page: 'Heat pump' is 'Optional in Plus', the only trim the page lists; no package is named. The status renders client-side, so it was read in the browser rather than from the saved HTML.

cargo_cu_ft.note: Volvo's '(max)' figures: second row up 18.9, rows folded 57.5. Also listed: 14.5 second row up, 34.1 first row up; frunk 0.7.
cargo_cu_ft.discrepancy: C/D lists 16 cu ft behind the second row (57.5 behind the first).

ground_clearance_in.note: Not given on Volvo's page; C/D 'Minimum Ground Clearance'.
